title: Unveiling LLM Observability with Traceloop's Gal Kleinman
description:
Dive into the fascinating world of LLM observability with Gal Kleinman, co-founder of Traceloop. Hosted by Simon Maple, this episode uncovers the intricacies of building effective evaluation suites for LLM applications. Discover the challenges, solutions, and best practices shared by Kleinman, an expert in engineering and product development.

What You'll Learn:
   - Understand the importance of robust evaluation suites.
   - Recognize unique challenges in LLM observability.
   - Explore tools like Open LLMetry for enhanced monitoring.
   - Learn best practices for setting alerts and thresholds.
   - Discover strategies for maintaining privacy and evaluation consistency.

This episode is perfect for developers and tech enthusiasts eager to master LLM observability and enhance their applications' performance.

How do you ensure observability in your LLM applications? Share your strategies in the comments! 👇

Chapters:
   0:00 - Episode highlight: LLM Observability challenges
   1:00 - Intro to guest and their role in the industry
   5:00 - Building effective evaluation suites for LLMs
   10:00 - The journey and success of Traceloop
   15:00 - Challenges in monitoring LLM flows
   20:00 - Introduction to Open LLMetry
   25:00 - Best practices for LLM observability
   30:00 - Ensuring privacy and evaluation consistency
   35:00 - Key takeaways and conclusion
